title: wkdoctor SDK Health Check HOW-TO
desc: T2 howto tier of wkdoctor-sdk-environment-health-check. Plugin architecture, how to add a new check, location, setup-check flow.
steps: LOCATION: bin/wkdoctor.ps1 (thin orchestrator) + bin/wkdoctor.cmd in SDK repo. Check logic lives in bin/wkappbot.hq/doctor/NN-name.ps1 plugins.

ARCHITECTURE: orchestrator dot-sources each NN-*.ps1 plugin in order; plugins call Add-Check and Emit from orchestrator scope. NO wkappbot subprocess calls (avoids Eye IPC stall) -- use PE VersionInfo + Get-Process + file APIs only.
HOW TO ADD A CHECK: create bin/wkappbot.hq/doctor/NN-yourcheck.ps1; inside call Add-Check '<name>' '<ok

fail>' '<detail>' AND Emit '<status>' '<name>' '<detail>'. Never throw (wrap in try/catch). Top-level return exits only that plugin (dot-source), safe. Copy 50-codex-symlink.ps1 or 06-defender-exclusions.ps1 as templates.

AUTO-REPAIR PATTERN: a plugin may fix what it finds (like 50-codex-symlink and 06-defender). For admin-required repairs: check IsInRole Administrator; if admin run the fix; if not, Start-Process powershell -Verb RunAs with a self-contained repair script (one UAC prompt), report warn + 're-run wkdoctor to verify'.
SETUP CHECK: run wkdoctor after fresh clone + setup.ps1 to verify environment. exit 0 = all pass, exit 1 = any fail. -Json for machine-readable (ConvertFrom-Json).
T1 core: wkdoctor-sdk-environment-health-check. T3 ref (full check list + history): wkdoctor-sdk-environment-health-check-ref.
